top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §746.901(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have a copy of their educational documents on file for review.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Preventing and Responding to Abuse and Neglect (26 TAC §746.501(a)(26))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policies did not include all the required information for abuse and neglect.

top_violation_types.title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The ground is splitting open and causing a tripping hazard at the entrance to the playground.       Photos taken

top_violation_types.title: Diaper Changing Steps-Supplies Kept Out of Child's Reach (26 TAC §746.3501(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Diaper changing supplies were within children's reach in two classrooms.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Activities for Infants - Outdoor Play Daily (26 TAC §746.2417(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: It was determined that the younger infant classroom has not being going outside.

top_violation_types.title: Incident/Illness Report Form Signed (26 TAC §746.705)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During a DFPS investigation it was found that the caregiver did not fill out the incident report and it was not filled out correctly.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
